target.title: improve(channels): reuse loaded plugin lookup view
target.body:
Closes #105972

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where message processing repeatedly sorted the loaded channel registry and rebuilt two lookup maps whenever callers read channel plugins from an unchanged runtime registry.

## Why This Change Was Made

The loaded registry view now uses one lifecycle-owned, single-slot cache keyed by the active runtime channel snapshot. Registry version changes still rebuild the deterministic sorted list and maps; unchanged snapshots reuse them. The separate linear-scan reader is folded into the canonical loaded-registry module so all loaded-only reads use one lookup path.

## User Impact

Repeated outbound, reply, and agent-message channel lookups avoid redundant registry iteration, sorting, and map allocation. Channel ordering and lookup behavior are unchanged; there are no config or plugin API changes.

## Evidence

- Before: the regression test on `cb5fc0ea8a53bafdd92e5fa106574fb559d7e7fe` observed three derived-view builds across three reads (`expected 3 to be 1`).
- After: the same test observes one build for the unchanged version and exactly one additional build after the registry version changes; deterministic `alpha`, `zeta` ordering is retained.
- Fresh Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcwp4pd5bhtwzfz928bbej1`: import-cycle, dependency, unused-file, deadcode-export, test-type, script-type, and root-test-type gates passed.
- Fresh Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcx3h5j4twdr0h42zqy8p25`: `pnpm build` and all 46 focused channel/outbound tests passed.
- Review follow-up on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcxyqffkg5xnfsh5tsggkx4`: targeted formatting passed and all 23 target-normalization tests passed with the partial registry-module mock.
- Earlier Blacksmith Testbox proof: all core/extension production and test `tsgo` lanes, full core/extension lint, and `pnpm format:check` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed. Fresh follow-up and final full-branch autoreviews found no actionable findings.
